pages: Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, stands at the glasshouse door in the cold, looking down the long run of bays. Middle: a hardback ledger on a shelf, a stack of rolled grow bags. Background: fogged glass, steel bars, cold white daylight.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, stands at the boiler house shelf with one hand on a hardback ledger ruled in five columns, a pencil beside it. Middle: a ring of greenhouse keys, a tin cup. Background: boiler, cast-iron returns, lamplight and grey window light.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, leans over the open ledger on the bench, one finger on the return column, tracing the same figure down the sheet. Middle: a boiler control box with round dials, a pocket thermometer. Background: pipes and lagging, lamplight.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, holds one long-stem probe in both hands, pushing the stem down into a trench in the concrete floor. Middle: the ledger lying open, a folding rule. Background: rows of tomato plants, glass roof, cold grey daylight.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, holds one wet bulb in one hand, a muslin sock on its glass stem, reading the two glass tubes. Middle: a printed chart pinned to the door, a tin of water. Background: boiler house wall, steam, lamplight.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, looks up at one aluminium glazing bar over bay three, her fingertip under a run of condensation sliding down it. Middle: brown fur on the stalks at the truss, a watering can. Background: fogged glass roof, flat overcast light.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, kneels on the floor of bay three with one long-stem probe pushed into the trench at the slab lip. Middle: the open ledger on the concrete, a notebook. Background: grey-dulled tomato rows, condensation on every pane, cold daylight.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, crouches at an open trench with the probe in her hand, water lying round a cast-iron pipe. Middle: the ledger on the slab lip, a torch. Background: grey tomato plants, sweating glass, cold white daylight.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, stands at the boiler house bench with one hand flat on the open ledger, her finger on a falling column of figures. Middle: a clip thermometer on the bench, a pencil. Background: boiler, return pipes, morning light through the window.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, clips one round white dial thermometer onto the fourth return pipe, black needle low. Middle: a gate valve on each pipe, the ledger open on the bench. Background: boiler house wall, hot pipes steaming, lamplight.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, holds the wet bulb close to one cold pipe, the muslin sock damp, the glass tube beside the hot ones. Middle: a towel on the floor, a bucket. Background: return pipes and lagging, lamplight, steam.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, kneels at a valve in the trench with one hand on a loop of soft copper wire twisted on the valve wheel. Middle: rust flakes, a spanner on the slab lip. Background: standing water in the trench, cold light from above.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, sits at the boiler house bench with one hand flat on an open service book, a finger on a single written line. Middle: the ledger open beside it, a pencil. Background: boiler, coils of pipe, grey window light.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, levers at a sump grate with a long steel bar, water rising round her boots across the bay. Middle: coir and tomato roots at the grate, grow bags. Background: standing flood over the slab, dim glass daylight.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, kneels on the wet bay floor with the ledger open before her, pencil writing one figure in the slab column. Middle: a torch on the concrete, a plant tag. Background: rows of wet plants, fogged glass, lamplight at six.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, stands at a bench in the packing shed holding one clipboard, a weigh scale dial behind her. Middle: crates of fruit stacked, a sack on a pallet. Background: shed walls, roller door light, cold morning.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, grips one thick hose running across the flooded bay toward a tanker. Middle: the copper wire off the valve wheel, a spanner. Background: bay three under water, plants standing in it, grey daylight through the roof.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, kneels on the drying floor of bay three with one long-stem probe pushed into the trench. Middle: the ledger open on the slab, a hose coiled. Background: plants greened up again, glass cleared, cold daylight.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, stands under the door bar of bay three, one hand up to the wet aluminium, a bead of water on it. Middle: the ledger with a pencil laid across it, a trough. Background: long rows, condensation on the glass, lamplight at night.

Tilly, sixteen, dark hair in a ponytail, a red fleece jacket over a grey t-shirt, kneels at the open ledger in the boiler house, one finger on a pencil question mark in the margin. Middle: the clip thermometer, a signed last line. Background: boiler, pipes, grey morning light through the window.
